name: KUKA KR 10 R1100 sixx (nominal, ROS 2 cell model)
source: https://github.com/ClaBirk/ROS2_Gazebo_Moveit_Simulation/tree/9a9ca52 (ros_sim/urdf/kr10_full_moveit_gazebo.xacro: joint origins, axes, limits, velocities); copied into roboCODE as ros2/robocode_kr10_description. Joint values equal the URDF joint values (joint_1..joint_6). Flange frame = URDF link_6 rotated +90 deg about Y (tool0 convention, Z out of the flange).
license: GPL-3.0-only (ClaBirk/ROS2_Gazebo_Moveit_Simulation); kinematic dimensions are nominal values of the KUKA KR 10 R1100 sixx and require calibration of the real robot
